title: Robust Machine Learning for Regulatory Sequence Modeling under Biological and Technical Distribution Shifts
abstract: arXiv:2601.14969v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robust machine learning for regulatory genomics is studied under biologically and technically induced distribution shifts. Deep convolutional and attention based models achieve strong in distribution performance on DNA regulatory sequence prediction tasks but are usually evaluated under i.i.d. assumptions, even though real applications involve cell type specific programs, evolutionary turnover, assay protocol changes, and sequencing artifacts. We introduce a robustness framework that combines a mechanistic simulation benchmark with real data analysis on a massively parallel reporter assay (MPRA) dataset to quantify performance degradation, calibration failures, and uncertainty based reliability. In simulation, motif driven regulatory outputs are generated with cell type specific programs, PWM perturbations, GC bias, depth variation, batch effects, and heteroscedastic noise, and CNN, BiLSTM, and transformer models are evaluated.

translated_title: 生物与技术分布偏移下调控序列建模的鲁棒机器学习
translated_abstract: 本研究探讨了在生物和技术因素引起的分布偏移下调控基因组学的鲁棒机器学习问题。基于深度卷积和注意力机制的模型在DNA调控序列预测任务上取得了较强的分布内性能，但通常是在独立同分布假设下进行评估的，而实际应用中会涉及细胞类型特异性程序、进化更替、实验方案变化和测序伪影。我们提出了一个鲁棒性评估框架，将机制仿真基准与大规模并行报告基因检测数据集的真实数据分析相结合，以量化性能退化、校准失效以及基于不确定性的可靠性。在仿真中，通过细胞类型特异性程序、PWM扰动、GC偏差、测序深度变化、批次效应和异方差噪声生成基序驱动的调控输出，并对CNN、BiLSTM和transformer模型进行了评估。
tldr: 提出了一个结合机制仿真基准与MPRA真实数据的鲁棒性评估框架，用于量化深度学习模型在生物与技术分布偏移下进行调控序列预测时的性能退化、校准失效与可靠性。
en_tdlr: A robustness evaluation framework combining a mechanistic simulation benchmark with real MPRA data analysis is proposed to quantify performance degradation, calibration failures, and uncertainty-based reliability of deep learning models for regulatory sequence prediction under biological and technical distribution shifts.
